The above Statement of Consolidated financial results have been prepared in accordance with the recognition and measurement principles laid down in the applicable Indian Accounting Standards ("Ind AS") as prescribed under section 133 of the Companies Act, 2013, as amended, read with relevant rules thereunder.

The above consolidated financial results (‘the Statement’) of the Global Surfaces Limited (''the Company'') and its subsidiaries (collectively ''the Group''), were reviewed by the Audit Committee and approved by the Board of Directors of the Company at their meeting held on November 02, 2026.

The Board, on recommendation of the Audit Committee, at its meeting held on August 10, 2026, approved conversion of a further portion of unsecured loan of AED 3,000,000 and USD 10,857,591 (aggregating and equivalent to total INR 1104.41 million) as on the Reference Date of June 30, 2026), into equity shares of the subsidiary, as per valuation determined by an independent valuer.
The necessary ODI-related filings under FEMA and regulatory formalities with the Jebel Ali Free Zone Authority (JAFZA), Dubai, are under process. This transaction does not involve any cash outflow from the Company.
